entities.summary: Kim Ung-Yong or Kim Woong-Yong is a South Korean civil engineer and professor. He is best known for being a child prodigy with the highest recorded IQ on record, having scored above 210 on the Stanford–Binet Intelligence Scale. He entered university at age 4 and at age 7, he received an invitation to work at ISRO. By age 5, he spoke five languages.
